selection_rule: First chronological daytime source on each prespecified new date; Aug14 and previously developed Aug17 excluded. No new-source model results used in selection.
before_prediction_actions: verify raw source bytes and provenance
predeclare contiguous passage windows with empty-channel context and censoring; do not choose windows by model results
source_kind: public raw monitor footage; no independent per-event labels claimed
reference_plan: publisher annotations where obtainable; original-scope user video acceptance does not automatically certify these new sessions
minimum_event_volume: 3-5 sessions/~100 passages is a suggested starting scale, not an achieved count or certification
